title: Grade 6 Math — Wed, Jun 18
description: Quadrilaterals — Day 3 of 5: Types of quadrilaterals
subject: mathematics

questions.question: How many sides does a quadrilateral have?
questions.explanation: A quadrilateral has exactly 4 sides. 'Quad' means four.

questions.question: A rectangle has ___.
questions.explanation: A rectangle has all four angles equal to 90°. Opposite sides are equal and parallel.

questions.question: A square is different from a rectangle because ___.
questions.explanation: A square has all sides equal AND all angles 90°. A rectangle has all angles 90° but sides need not all be equal.

questions.question: A rhombus has ___.
options: Only one pair of parallel sides
questions.explanation: A rhombus has all four sides equal. Its angles need not be 90°.

questions.question: A parallelogram has ___.
options: Only one pair of parallel sides
Two pairs of parallel, equal opposite sides
questions.explanation: A parallelogram has two pairs of opposite sides that are parallel and equal in length.

questions.question: A trapezium has ___.
options: Exactly one pair of parallel sides
questions.explanation: A trapezium has exactly one pair of parallel sides.

questions.question: In a kite, ___.
options: Two pairs of adjacent sides are equal
questions.explanation: A kite has two pairs of adjacent (next to each other) sides that are equal in length.

questions.question: The sum of all interior angles of a quadrilateral is ___.
questions.explanation: Any quadrilateral's interior angles add up to 360°.

questions.question: A square is a special type of ___.
questions.explanation: A square is a special rectangle (all angles 90°) and also a special rhombus (all sides equal).

questions.question: Which quadrilateral has all sides equal but not necessarily all angles equal to 90°?
questions.explanation: A rhombus has all sides equal, but its angles are not necessarily 90° — unless it is a square.

questions.question: Which quadrilateral is NOT a parallelogram?
questions.explanation: A trapezium has only one pair of parallel sides, so it is NOT a parallelogram (which requires two pairs).

questions.question: How many pairs of parallel sides does a parallelogram have?
questions.explanation: A parallelogram has exactly 2 pairs of parallel sides — that is its defining property.

questions.question: Which shape has all sides equal AND all angles 90°?
questions.explanation: A square satisfies both: all sides equal (like a rhombus) and all angles 90° (like a rectangle).

questions.question: How many diagonals does a quadrilateral have?
questions.explanation: A quadrilateral has exactly 2 diagonals — lines joining non-adjacent (opposite) vertices.

questions.question: Identify the quadrilateral: one pair of parallel sides; the non-parallel sides are equal in length.
questions.explanation: An isosceles trapezium has one pair of parallel sides and the non-parallel sides (legs) are equal in length.
